The data product should be structured to support trend analysis, cross‑segment comparisons, and “what‑if” scenario testing of discount‑rate and other key assumption changes on earnings, pension expense, and goodwill impairment outcomes.

Collect a consolidated dataset of consumer loan balances, net of unearned income, that includes the following fields for each reporting period: total loan amount (in billions of dollars), on‑balance‑sheet loan balances, securitized receivables (all cards), credit‑card receivables held‑for‑sale, and the overall total managed. Collect a comprehensive, year‑level dataset of railroad performance and financial statistics reported to the Association of American Railroads, including average train speed, average terminal dwell time, average rail‑car inventory, gross ton‑miles, revenue ton‑miles, operating ratio, employee headcount, customer‑satisfaction index, carload volumes, commodity‑mix breakdown, weather/maintenance disruptions, fuel‑price impacts, and capital‑investment activities, together with net income, average equity and return on average common‑shareholder equity; enable analysis of trends over time, assessment of how operational drivers (volume changes, commodity shifts, external events) influence efficiency metrics, and evaluation of the relationship between operational performance and financial results.

Create a comprehensive, reusable dataset that consolidates Comcast Corporation’s deferred tax liability information for fiscal years 2014 and 2015, including opening balances, detailed additions (current‑year tax positions, prior‑year tax positions, acquisitions) and reductions (prior‑year positions, statute‑of‑limitations expirations, settlements), and closing balances.
